coverage_slots.description: The user is entering, orienting, gaining access, or setting up before the primary task.
coverage_slots.inclusion_rule: Include discovery, access, consent, registration, and initial setup before commitment.
coverage_slots.exclusion_rule: Exclude active transactions, waiting states, completed outcomes, failures, and support escalation.

coverage_slots.description: The user is evaluating, choosing, configuring, or initiating the primary consequential task.
coverage_slots.inclusion_rule: Include comparisons, qualification, selection, purchase, request, submission, and management actions.
coverage_slots.exclusion_rule: Exclude early orientation, waiting, completed outcomes, failures, and support-only journeys.

coverage_slots.description: A task has started and its result or next state is still pending.
coverage_slots.inclusion_rule: Include processing, waiting, tracking, queued, and in-progress states.
coverage_slots.exclusion_rule: Exclude tasks that have not started, completed outcomes, failures, and general information.

coverage_slots.description: The user goal or system task is explicitly complete and its outcome is confirmed.
coverage_slots.inclusion_rule: Include confirmed completion, receipt, approval, delivery, or other achieved outcomes.
coverage_slots.exclusion_rule: Exclude readiness, promotional calls to action, selection, and work that is still pending.

coverage_slots.description: A failure or blocking condition prevents the intended task and offers a corrective path.
coverage_slots.inclusion_rule: Include errors, unavailable states, rejected input, failed processing, and corrective recovery.
coverage_slots.exclusion_rule: Exclude routine support discovery, safety reporting, permissions, and voluntary destructive actions.

coverage_slots.description: The user needs help, handles safety or permission concerns, or considers a consequential reversal or destructive action.
coverage_slots.inclusion_rule: Include support routing, fraud or safety response, permission gates, cancellation, refund, return, and destructive confirmation.
coverage_slots.exclusion_rule: Exclude ordinary authentication, product discovery, routine task progress, and completed outcomes.

journey_families.description: Enter an account, market, locale, or protected product surface.
journey_families.inclusion_rule: Include authentication, account entry, and localization entry.
journey_families.exclusion_rule: Exclude registration, product evaluation, and ongoing account management.

journey_families.description: Initiate or confirm the primary consequential action.
journey_families.inclusion_rule: Include buying, paying, booking, requesting, submitting, creating, configuring, or activating.
journey_families.exclusion_rule: Exclude comparison, orientation, progress tracking, and completed outcomes.

journey_families.description: Receive confirmation that the intended outcome is complete.
journey_families.inclusion_rule: Include explicit completion, receipt, approval, or delivered outcome.
journey_families.exclusion_rule: Exclude readiness, next-step prompts, and pending states.

journey_families.description: Find and understand available information, categories, products, or services.
journey_families.inclusion_rule: Include browsing, searching, learning, and initial orientation.
journey_families.exclusion_rule: Exclude comparison decisions, commitment, management, and recovery.

journey_families.description: Assess fit, eligibility, value, price, trust, or alternatives before choosing.
journey_families.inclusion_rule: Include qualification, comparison, risk assessment, and selection preparation.
journey_families.exclusion_rule: Exclude initial browsing, final commitment, and post-commitment progress.

journey_families.description: Operate or maintain an existing account, service, workspace, or configuration.
journey_families.inclusion_rule: Include updating settings, usage, billing, listings, and ongoing administration.
journey_families.exclusion_rule: Exclude initial setup, one-time commitment, and failure recovery.

journey_families.description: Register, enrol, apply, consent, or complete initial setup for participation.
journey_families.inclusion_rule: Include signup, recruitment, enrolment, application, consent, and guided setup.
journey_families.exclusion_rule: Exclude ordinary account access and ongoing management.

journey_families.description: Track or wait for an action already underway.
journey_families.inclusion_rule: Include pending, processing, queued, tracking, and fulfillment progress.
journey_families.exclusion_rule: Exclude actions not yet started and completed outcomes.

journey_families.description: Correct a failure, reverse a decision, or restore a disrupted task.
journey_families.inclusion_rule: Include error correction, cancellation, refund, return, reconnect, and billing resolution.
journey_families.exclusion_rule: Exclude routine help discovery and safety reporting without a failed task.

journey_families.description: Recognize, prevent, or report fraud, security, emergency, or harm.
journey_families.inclusion_rule: Include fraud recognition, emergency response, incident reporting, and safety controls.
journey_families.exclusion_rule: Exclude general trust evaluation and routine support.

journey_families.description: Find or contact assistance for a question or issue.
journey_families.inclusion_rule: Include help discovery, issue routing, contact, and self-service support.
journey_families.exclusion_rule: Exclude direct error correction when the failure state itself is central.

state_classes.description: The next meaningful action can be taken.
state_classes.inclusion_rule: Include ready-to-act and actionable next-step states.
state_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude choices, required input, processing, completion, and failure.

state_classes.description: Identity or account access must be established.
state_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude registration, consent, and ordinary permission prompts.

state_classes.description: The intended task cannot continue without resolving a blocking condition.
state_classes.inclusion_rule: Include unavailable, ineligible, restricted, or unresolved prerequisite states.
state_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude recoverable field errors and ordinary choice states.

state_classes.description: The user must compare or select among alternatives.
state_classes.inclusion_rule: Include plan, product, provider, market, or mode selection.
state_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude free-form input, commitment confirmation, and information-only states.

state_classes.description: The intended task or outcome is explicitly complete.
state_classes.inclusion_rule: Include confirmed, approved, received, delivered, or finished states.

state_classes.description: The user must grant informed consent or accept a permission boundary.
state_classes.inclusion_rule: Include privacy consent and explicit permission decisions.
state_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude authentication and ordinary action confirmation.

state_classes.description: A consequential reversal or destructive action awaits confirmation.
state_classes.inclusion_rule: Include cancellation, deletion, return, refund, stop, or transfer confirmation.
state_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude failure correction and routine account management.

state_classes.description: The attempted task has failed or contains an actionable error.
state_classes.inclusion_rule: Include validation errors, failed processing, rejected attempts, and broken states.
state_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude unavailable prerequisites and safety risks.

state_classes.description: Relevant information is available without an immediate required action.
state_classes.inclusion_rule: Include browsing, explanation, guidance, definitions, and informational navigation.
state_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude choice, input, processing, completion, and failure.

state_classes.description: The user must provide data to continue.
state_classes.inclusion_rule: Include forms, search queries, location entry, and required transaction details.
state_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude authentication credentials when identity access is the primary purpose.

state_classes.description: A system or account permission must be granted before continuing.
state_classes.inclusion_rule: Include access authorization and capability permission gates.
state_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude informed content consent and authentication.

state_classes.description: The task is underway and awaiting a result.
state_classes.inclusion_rule: Include pending, queued, processing, tracking, and in-progress states.

state_classes.description: A safety, security, fraud, or harm condition requires attention.
state_classes.inclusion_rule: Include suspected fraud, emergency, security incident, and safety risk.
state_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude general trust evaluation without an active risk.

state_classes.description: Help or escalation paths are available.
state_classes.inclusion_rule: Include help centers, contact routes, issue navigation, and assistance options.
state_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude the failure state itself when recovery is directly actionable.

content_slot_classes.description: A control that initiates or confirms the primary action.
content_slot_classes.inclusion_rule: Include buttons, calls to action, and consent actions.
content_slot_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude navigation links, labels, and status messages.

content_slot_classes.description: Explanatory or supporting prose associated with the current state.
content_slot_classes.inclusion_rule: Include body copy, introductory text, definitions, expectations, and value explanations.
content_slot_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude headings, controls, labels, and status feedback.

content_slot_classes.description: Information that qualifies risk, price, availability, timing, or consequences.
content_slot_classes.inclusion_rule: Include warnings, qualifiers, price disclosures, delivery expectations, and risk statements.

content_slot_classes.description: Feedback indicating readiness, acceptance, or completion.
content_slot_classes.inclusion_rule: Include confirmation messages tied to an action or outcome.

content_slot_classes.description: Feedback describing a failure and corrective path.
content_slot_classes.inclusion_rule: Include inline, field, page, and system errors.

content_slot_classes.description: Feedback describing a current non-error state or progress.
A label or field prompt that identifies required input.
content_slot_classes.inclusion_rule: Include field labels, location states, and form labels.
content_slot_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude search controls and action buttons.

content_slot_classes.description: The main heading that establishes the page or task purpose.
content_slot_classes.inclusion_rule: Include hero, page, product, offer, pricing, and proposition headings.
content_slot_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude subordinate section headings and item titles.

content_slot_classes.description: A subordinate heading that structures a section or topic.
content_slot_classes.inclusion_rule: Include section, FAQ, category, filter, support, question, and topic headings.

content_slot_classes.description: The title of a discrete product, course, program, or content item.
content_slot_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude page headings and navigation labels.

content_slot_classes.description: A short non-interactive label naming a feature, mode, or semantic category.
content_slot_classes.inclusion_rule: Include feature labels, mode labels, and compact classification labels.
content_slot_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude form labels, headings, navigation, and action controls.

content_slot_classes.description: A label or link used to move between destinations or issue routes.
content_slot_classes.inclusion_rule: Include navigation, support links, and service-taxonomy routes.
content_slot_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude primary task actions and search controls.

content_slot_classes.description: A control used to search, filter, or report result scope.
content_slot_classes.inclusion_rule: Include search fields, filter headings, and result-count controls.
content_slot_classes.exclusion_rule: Exclude general form labels and navigation.

surface_channels.description: A browser-delivered interface or public web surface.
surface_channels.inclusion_rule: Include responsive and desktop browser surfaces.
surface_channels.exclusion_rule: Exclude native mobile, email, voice, messaging, and physical channels.
